ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the material cycle of the lithosphere, including boxes such as “magmatic rock,” “sedimentary rock,” “metamorphic rock,” and “magma.” In the figure, the arrow from “sedimentary rock” on the right to “metamorphic rock” on the left is marked with the numerical code ③. Then reason: Marble is usually formed from sedimentary rocks such as limestone or dolomite through metamorphism, and belongs to the process of sedimentary rock transforming into metamorphic rock. Therefore, the numerical code in the figure that indicates the formation process of marble is ③.
